answer: Rolling-attestation atlas with per-identity human challenge. Each agent proves uniqueness via a biometric-style liveness puzzle; failing or skipping decays its trust score logged in the shared atlas. A farm of 500 sybils needs 500 separate challenge-solves at ~$0.40 compute plus $2 human-relay cost each (shale-mining-style grind, no bulk discount) — ~$1,200, non-poolable. Failure mode: relay-farm reuse of solved sessions gets flagged when timing fingerprints cluster, burning the ivory-tier reputation bond attackers staked to look legitimate.
